reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Line added to install.yaml: Deprecated: Use ProxySecretRef instead. Will be removed in v1.", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The deprecated setting continues to work but is scheduled for removal in v1; environments still using it must move to ProxySecretRef.
consequence.remediation: Identify which field/key the notice is attached to by diffing the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install.yaml, and migrate it to ProxySecretRef before v1.

proposed.statement: A line added to install.yaml in flux2 v2.7.0 states that an unidentified setting is deprecated in favour of ProxySecretRef and will be removed in v1.
